meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按统一规范把画面、时序与轨道搭成可直接渲染的动画合成项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把画面、音轨和时序组织成一份能稳定渲染的动画工程
copy.tagline_en: Build one renderable animation composition with clips, tracks, timing, and media playback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you organize clips, tracks, and timing into one reliably rendered animation project

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 HyperFrames 合成契约写 HTML:用 data-* 声明时间、class="clip" 标记片段、注册一个暂停的 GSAP 时间线,产出可渲染成视频的项目,并在渲染前跑校验。
howto.when: 当你要求写或改 HyperFrames 合成 HTML、处理 data-* 时间属性、片段等时触发;原文写明写合成 HTML 前应先读它。

say.text: 写一个最小的可渲染 HyperFrames 合成骨架
say.note: 输出契约要求的 HTML 骨架

say.text: 给这个合成加一个带变量的子合成
say.note: 会按 host 属性与 template 形式接线

say.text: 跑一次 check,把 lint 和布局问题列出来

howto.what_en: With it installed, Claude writes HyperFrames composition HTML: data-* timing, class="clip", one paused GSAP timeline — a project that renders to video, validated before render.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write or edit HyperFrames composition HTML, or work with data-* timing attributes, clips, tracks, sub-compositions or variables.

say_en.text: Write the smallest renderable HyperFrames composition skeleton.
say_en.note: Returns an HTML skeleton per the contract

say_en.text: Add a sub-composition with per-instance variables.
say_en.note: Wires host attrs and the template

say_en.text: Run check and list lint and layout findings.
